stem: ![](asset:P000249-stem-1)Two particles A and B are projected simultaneously as shown in the figure: A with a speed of 20 m/s at an angle θ with the horizontal, and B vertically upward with a speed of 10 m/s. The horizontal distance between them is x = 10 m. If the particles collide in air, how many seconds after projection does the collision occur?
